data.description: Query surveillance events that occurred within a specified time and zone
data.descriptionEn: Query surveillance events that occurred within a specified time and zone
data.descriptionZh: 查询指定时间和区域内发生了哪些监控事件
data.readme:
· Filter events by time, camera, or zone
· Search for people, vehicles, pets, etc
· Results are shown as event cards with timestamps and screenshots
data.readmeEn:
· Filter events by time, camera, or zone
· Search for people, vehicles, pets, etc
· Results are shown as event cards with timestamps and screenshots
data.readmeZh:
· 支持按时间段、摄像头、区域筛选事件
· 可查询人、车、宠物等不同类型
· 结果以事件卡片形式展示，含截图和时间
